thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE (sev=1) - dedpool node SIGFAULT / GPU crash detected in pool 'peregrine-dedicated' on node n-prod-7. Affects a subset of tenant Peregrine jobs. Paging oncall-sre and eng-runtime/infra.

maria.sre: ack. I'm on it. Can someone paste current task count and if any long-running traces are stuck? @ben.runtime @sasha.infra

ben.runtime: looking. Metrics show a sharp spike in GPU driver errors at 2026-03-14T02:04Z, replication factor dropped for some transformers. Latency SLOs breached for ~2% of Peregrine requests. No data-plane auth anomalies.

sasha.infra: I'm checking node health now. `ssh n-prod-7` shows kernel Oops and repeated `NVRM` lines in dmesg. Suspect GPU driver panic.

maria.sre: ok, plan: 1) cordon/evacuate node 2) isolate affected tenant to fallback pool 3) spin up replacement node 4) notify customer and CS. Assigning roles: sasha infra for cordon/drain, ben runtime for traffic routing & model fallback, alice-cs for external comms.

sasha.infra: executing cordon and drain.

sasha.infra: Command:
```
# Mark unschedulable and start eviction
rictl node cordon n-prod-7
rictl node drain n-prod-7 --timeout 600 --grace 30 --force
```

sasha.infra: Also keeping legacy k8s fallback:
```
kubectl cordon n-prod-7
kubectl drain n-prod-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30
```

devops-bot: Drain job started for n-prod-7 by sasha.infra at 2267001240. Eviction status: 0/12 pods evicted.

ben.runtime: Starting automatic routing to fallback pool for Peregrine tenants. Using policy `fallback:dedicated-standby` with gradual shift to avoid thundering herd.

ben.runtime: CLI:
```
rictl routing set --tenant peregrine --policy fallback:dedicated-standby --rollout 50%
```

maria.sre: We're seeing a few pod restarts due to GPU init failures when they land on other nodes; starting small rollout helps. Monitoring cache/KV hotness.

alice-cs: pinging Peregrine support & AM: "We detected GPU node failure in your dedicated pool. We're routing your traffic to a standby pool, there is limited impact to 2% of requests. We'll provide updates and timeline for replacement." Will post copy here.

alice-cs: message to customer posted to their escalation channel. cc @account-amy. :email:

account-amy: thanks, please include any ETA on RMA or replacement once we have it. I'll standby for exec questions.

sasha.infra: Evictions progressing: 7/12 pods evicted. One pod failed reschedule due to GPU plugin load error on target node. Will try targeted restart on healthy host.

maria.sre: Noting that two jobs were pinned to the failed GPU device (NVLink attached). Ben, can you confirm roledown for pinned workloads?

ben.runtime: Confirmed. Pinned jobs are getting moved to CPU fallback or amortized onto other GPUs depending on model size. We applied config:
```
model-placement:
  allow-cpu-fallback: true
  fallback-queue: peregrine-standby
```

devops-bot: Autoscaler triggered new node provisioning in region us-west-2 (new node id n-prod-17). Provision started at 2267001258.

sasha.infra: Starting hardware diagnostics capture and collecting `nvidia-smi -q` and kernel logs for RMA.

sasha.infra: `dmesg` snippet:
```
[  123.456789] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3e:00): 13, pid=4123, GPU reported a problem, triggering reset
[  123.456900] kernel: watchdog: GPU hung, calling emergency reset
```

maria.sre: Filing incident ticket to HW vendor, attaching logs. Tentative root cause: GPU driver reliability regression under certain mem patterns. Marking as "driver crash" until proven otherwise.

leo.oncall: I'm taking the handoff at 2267001268 (next shift). Summary: cordoned n-prod-7, drain in progress, fallback routing at 50%, new node provisioning started. No customer data exposure. I will keep the rollout at 50% until drains complete.

sasha.infra: Drain completed at 2267001275. All pods either rescheduled or terminated. Node set to quarantine.

devops-bot: Node n-prod-7 quarantined, state=decomission_pending. RMA ticket #RMA-9817 created.

ben.runtime: Increasing routing to 100% to standby pool now that drains completed.

ben.runtime: `rictl routing set --tenant peregrine --policy fallback:dedicated-standby --rollout 100%`

alice-cs: Updated customer: "All traffic now on standby pool, we expect normal service. We're replacing affected hardware and will update when RMA completes." Customer replied: "Thanks, please keep us posted." :thumbsup:

maria.sre: Scheduling postmortem with eng-runtime + infra + SRE. Short-term action items: driver pin to last-known-good in pool images; add kernel oops alert to dedpool SLOs; update runbook for cordon/drain with pinned-model steps.

account-amy: Noting customer wants timeline. Please add ETA to RMA and replacement node boot time to the ticket.

sasha.infra: Vendor RMA estimated 48-72h, but hotspare node will be in service within ~10m from provisioning once healthy. New node n-prod-17 joined and passed GPU smoke tests at 2267001289.

devops-bot: Node n-prod-17 ready. Rebalance will start in 5 minutes. `rictl node replace --old n-prod-7 --new n-prod-17`

ben.runtime: Rebalance applied. Verified Peregrine traffic gradually shifted back from standby to primary pool where capacity allows. Observability shows error rates returning to baseline.

maria.sre: handing off final monitoring to leo.oncall. I'll draft postmortem and assign action owners. Closing the active paging loop. :white_check_mark:

leo.oncall: taking over. Will run post-incident checklist and confirm follow-ups. Closing thread when postmortem link is posted.

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged as "mitigated" at 2267001299. Channel: incidents. Follow-up: postmortem required.
